title: Interactive SAML setup wizard with metadata exchange simulator and strict validation
creator: Aisha Fernandez
description: Goal: Ship an interactive SAML 2.0 Setup wizard in the Console that guides admins through metadata exchange, validates XML signatures and cert chains, simulates certificate rotation, and surfaces actionable errors and audit events. Scope: 1) Console flow (admin-only, behind feature flag) for SP metadata generation and IdP metadata upload/URL entry. 2) Robust validation pipeline: XML schema checks, signed metadata verification, certificate chain and key usage checks, fingerprint collision detection, and time-window checks (validFrom/validUntil). 3) A metadata exchange simulator that can make test AuthnRequest/Response roundtrips (mock IdP) to verify EntityID, ACS URL, NameID formats, and response signatures. 4) Audit logging of every metadata upload, validation result, and simulated auth exchange with searchable fields (uploader, fingerprint, validation errors). 5) Clear remediation guidance in UI and authenticated API endpoints for programmatic setup. Acceptance criteria: - Admins can complete SP -> IdP metadata exchange end-to-end without requiring SRE. - Validation errors are specific (e.g., "metadata missing KeyDescriptor for signing", "certificate expired on 2025-02-10", "multiple entityIDs detected"). - Metadata signing is verified using the standard XML-DSIG libraries and we detect unsigned metadata when signature_required feature flag is on. - Certificate rotation simulation can demonstrate both old and new certs and show which sessions will be affected. - All steps produce audit records compatible with our audit log schema and exported to the observability pipeline. - API endpoints for uploading metadata return structured error codes and link to remediation docs. Implementation notes: - Use existing XML validation library (xmllint/Xerces or python-lxml) with strict namespace handling. - Use our signing verification microservice (security-auth/metadata-verifier) but add extended checks for nested KeyDescriptor elements and cert chain parsing. - Implement simulator as a local test harness in the console backend that can optionally hit a sandbox IdP (saml-sandbox.redwood.local). - Add telemetry events: saml.metadata.uploaded, saml.metadata.validation_result, saml.simulator.run, saml.certificate.rotation_simulation. - Feature gate: saml_console_wizard (default: disabled for orgs until enabled by Support). - UX: show a collapsible raw metadata panel, a parsed summary (entityID, ACS, certificates, valid windows), and a color-coded validation summary (green/orange/red). - RBAC: only Org Admins + Security Admin role can run wizard and see certificates. Rollback/Recovery: If a bad metadata upload causes a regression we will allow revert to previous metadata via a one-click rollback and emit a notice to affected sessions. We will also include a rate limit to prevent mass replaces. Monitoring/SLOs: Track validation latency (target <500ms per uploaded file), simulator roundtrip latency, and error rates. Create dashboard in Console > Security > SAML Setup. Security considerations: Do not persist raw IdP private keys; log fingerprints rather than full cert text in standard logs. Ensure KMS-encrypted storage for any stored cert blobs. Documentation: update Confluence runbook and implement step-by-step guides with sample IdPs (Okta, ADFS, OneLogin) and troubleshooting examples.
comments: 2025-02-19 - Kickoff: Drafted flow with PM (Priya Kumar) and Design (Marco Li). We agreed on an interactive simulator rather than just static validation to reduce followups from customers.

2025-02-22 - Tech review: Decided to reuse security-auth/metadata-verifier for signature checks and add a lightweight cert-chain parser in Go to run inside the console backend. Daniel volunteered to own the parser component.
2025-02-26 - UX review: Design provided wireframes that include three columns: parsed summary, raw XML, and simulator results. Action: implement parser to return structured summary used by the UI.

2025-03-01 - Security review preliminary: Flagged need to avoid logging full certificate PEMs to standard logs; changed audit shape to include cert_thumbprint and truncated PEM. Added security_review_required=true.

2025-03-03 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4823 implementing metadata upload endpoint and basic XML validation. Linking PR and requesting architect review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4823

2025-03-04 - QA plan: Create unit tests for malformed metadata, expired certs, and duplicate entityIDs. Integration tests will run simulator against saml-sandbox and verify audit events show up in observability pipeline (dashboard link below).

2025-03-04 - Blocker noted: Some vendor metadata uses non-standard namespace prefixes that the strict parser rejects. Plan: add a permissive pre-normalizer that rebinds prefixes before strict validation. Ticket created for normalizer: ENG-27011.
2025-03-04 - Next steps: finalize PR, add telemetry events, and schedule security sign-off. Daniel to coordinate with Support for early testing with 2 customers under feature flag.
